I cannot afford chemical fertilizer from the shop, and this plot is rented, so I will use what I have at home. I will spread some compost and manure on it, and sow seed I kept from last year's harvest. My family and I will weed by hand and depend on the rains; we can manage this small piece without hiring outside workers.
